race.description: Triple M Riverina Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: MAGIC BUS (11) made the right sort of debut at Goulburn, finishing third to Bold Conquer after being bumped early and still having work to do in the straight. He was respected in betting, draws kindly in barrier 2 and gets Pierre Boudvillain, so the exposed run gives him the strongest winning platform. GOLD DECREE (3) is the danger on consistency, having run second at his past two and only gone under by a long neck at this track after racing wide throughout. The reservation is that 13-start maiden record, although his two placings from two runs at this venue keep him firmly in the race. EYES RIGHT (13) resumed with a solid second at Wagga Riverside and also has an Open placing at this track, with the 2kg claim adding to her case. SHEZRUSHIN (8) was bumped on debut and beaten just under two lengths, so natural improvement can put her into the placings despite the outside draw.
